name: Minase Mei
source:
A lonely and gloomy girl being bullied.
Always afraid of strangers.
Since she has been treated badly at school and even home, she never experienced what is being loved. But after being helped by the main character, she opened up to him.
Thinking that he is the only one in the world who cares for her, she is blindly in love with the main character.
For him, she will even become a slutty slave...
